seams.title: Carry the amount of mana a mana ability produced on its event
seams.clause: Each creature you control has "Whenever a mana ability of this creature resolves, put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the amount of mana this creature produced. This ability triggers only once each turn."
seams.why: game.EventManaAbilityActivated (server/internal/game/mutations.go, emitted by both the clicked activation and the auto-tapper) carries Actor, Source, CardID, Label and Exhaust but no amount, and it is emitted before the slots are minted. A trigger needs the count of mana that ability actually produced (after CR 106.12b-style replacements such as tripling, not counting other permanents' triggered mana). Expect an additive Amount (or a new 'mana ability resolved' event) in mutations.go / produce_mana.go, then a granted trigger with the existing once-each-turn guard (docs/adding-cards.md '"This ability triggers only once"', #5245). The 'Elves attack, they gain deathtouch' half is ordinary.
seams.checked: grep -rliE 'Whenever a mana ability of|amount of mana .* produced|tap(s|ped)? .* for mana, put' in server/internal/cards/effects/ -> no file. grep 'ManaAbilityResolved|ManaProduced|EventManaAdded|EventManaAbilityActivated' in server/internal/game -> the event exists (manaActivationPing in mana_rider_helpers.go watches it for Zhur-Taa Druid) but neither it nor ManaProduced (mana_trigger.go: Source, Controller, Colors) is delivered to an ordinary trigger with a total. EventManaAdded is one event per unit with no ability grouping.

seams.title: Grant jump-start to graveyard cards that are exactly two colours
seams.clause: Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard that's exactly two colors has jump-start.
seams.why: A granted graveyard keyword is a game.CastPermission with an AltCostKey (Lier: "flashback"). server/internal/game/cast_permission.go resolves granted keys case by case (miracle, sneak, mayhem, madness, harmonize, flashback) and has none for jump-start, whose price is the card's mana cost PLUS discarding a card (CR 702.133a) and exile on leaving the stack; and PermissionFilter can say ColorsAny but not 'exactly two colours' of the card in the zone. Both are additive fields/branches in cast_permission.go; the offer itself can reuse cmdr2S39JumpStart's shape. Hexproof from monocolored already exists.
seams.checked: grep -rliE 'ha(s|ve) jump-start|ha(s|ve) flashback|ha(s|ve) escape' -> lier_disciple_of_the_drowned.go, underworld_breach.go, iroh_grand_lotus.go (flashback/escape only). grep -i 'jump-start' in server/internal/cards/effects/ -> radical_idea.go and cmdr2_s39_helpers.go (the card's OWN alternative cost, not a grant). grep 'jump-start|JumpStart' in server/internal/game -> nothing. Read PermissionFilter's fields: no colour-count filter.

seams.title: Replace damage that would remove a planeswalker's last loyalty counter
seams.clause: As long as you control a creature, if damage dealt to a planeswalker you control of the chosen type would result in all loyalty counters on it being removed, instead all but one of those counters are removed.
seams.why: Damage to a planeswalker removes loyalty inside applyDamageToPermanentLocked (server/internal/game/damage_tail.go, the CR 120.3c / 306.8 split) with no window that can change the RESULT of the damage for a planeswalker; the nearest hook is damageResultAsThoughLocked (damage_as_though.go, wither as-though). The damage is still dealt in full (lifelink, 'dealt damage' triggers), only the counter removal is capped, so it is not a prevention. Needs a static-declared cap read as the damage lands, keyed on the chosen planeswalker type and 'you control a creature'. The 'choose a planeswalker type' prompt and the hexproof static have precedent (leori_sparktouched_hunter.go, game.PlaneswalkerTypes).
seams.checked: grep -rliE 'would result in all loyalty counters|all but one of those counters' in server/internal/cards/effects/ -> no file. grep 'loyalty' in server/internal/game/damage*.go -> only the CR 120.3 comment in damage_tail.go. grep 'choose a planeswalker type' -> leori_sparktouched_hunter.go (the choice exists). Replacement event kinds in replacements.go cover Move, Mill, ETB, CreateTokens, Counter (placement), ProduceMana, Discard, Draw, Life, Damage: none for counters REMOVED by damage.
